judgments.reason: The support span 'PVB19 DNA was found (viral load of 0.2 PVB19 DNA copies/β-globin gene copy, or 33,438 copies/μg of isolated DNA) in lesional skin biopsy specimen' appears literally in the vignette and directly confirms PVB19 presence in skin lesions, clinically supporting the modifier 'with cutaneous manifestations' as part of the completed diagnosis.
